tree_hash_format: For each regular file recursively under the artifact-set root: relative POSIX path + NUL (0x00) + lowercase hexadecimal file SHA-256 + LF (0x0A), sorted by relative path using ordinal case-sensitive order; SHA-256 the UTF-8 byte stream. Empty stream hashes normally.
combined_tree_hash_format: For run then quality_check: artifact-set label + NUL (0x00) + lowercase tree SHA-256 + LF (0x0A); SHA-256 the UTF-8 byte stream.

initial_capture_sort_compatibility_note.note: The initial scratch-only PowerShell aggregate used culture-sensitive Sort-Object despite a case-sensitive flag. Per-file hashes were unchanged. The persisted canonical values use the declared ordinal POSIX-path order.

legacy_artifact_manifest_audit.policy: read_only_audit; legacy manifest and raw artifacts are not rewritten
